author: Dickelbers
attribution: Photo: Dickelbers, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Swaziland_police_sign.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Blue fascia panel with the police crest over a glass entrance; reflections of trees and a vehicle in the windows. No camera location, so the specific station is unknown; the force is now the Royal Eswatini Police Service.

author: thomas
attribution: Photo: thomas, CC BY-SA 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mantenga_Craft_(7045502495)_(9).jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Arrow-shaped signpost with hanging name boards at Mantenga Craft Centre near Ezulwini. Small caps lettering on the first three boards (large initial letters). 'Rosecraft WEAVING' shop sign at the right and a partly hidden banner behind are distractors. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Bernard Gagnon
attribution: Photo: Bernard Gagnon, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Signs_in_Eswatini.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Junction near Lobamba with brown tourist signs (bed and kudu pictograms) and a green route sign with orange route numbers. Small red ribbon stickers on the green sign. The lower brown sign has only police and museum pictograms with '2.5 km'. A 'LODGE' board on the hill at the far left is cut off. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
